correctness.rationale: For all stable real 2×2 B and D>0, an exact symbolic identity B^TQ+QB=tr(B)Q proves the centered drift-only angular activity is a generator eigenfunction. Gaussian stationary Lyapunov theory and semigroup conditioning yield the all-lag positive exponential covariance; Wick, quadratic-form transformation, and the sign of det Q=det B-tr(B)^2/4 give the remaining formulas and exact node/focus/repeated-root classification. Five independent rational examples, four lags per case, and 77 deterministic checker assertions corroborate all critical steps; the proof does not depend on sampling or incomplete enumeration.

value.rationale: The physically motivated drift-only orbital observable avoids the ill-defined instantaneous noise derivative, yet its autocorrelation collapses to one universal rate even for nonnormal and complex drift spectra. A complete sharp node/focus/repeated-root sign-support classification distinguishes deterministic rotational bias from stochastic path-angular momentum, applies to arbitrary positive diffusion, and gives exact integrated finite-time fluctuations. These are structural boundaries useful as reproducible gyrator diagnostic benchmarks; this is not a generic parameter substitution or a new Gaussian covariance calculation.
